title: MongoDB sharded cluster-status: 3 config RS + 2 shard RSes + 2 mongos
description: Introspects the live Phase 0.N sharded cluster the way the nexus-cli MongoShardedAdapter cluster-status verb will: registered shards + balancer via mongos, per-shard replica-set health via the shard mongods, and chunk distribution across shards. Auth is split by node role -- mongos forbids the `local` DB so client ops authenticate as `nexus-sharded-admin` against `admin` (created on the config servers by role-overlay-mongo-add-shards.tf), while direct shard-mongod probes use the keyFile `__system` user against `local`. Until the adapter lands (later unified CLI phase) the same checks run over SSH + mongosh.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.58 "KF=\$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-mongo/keyfile | tr -d '\n'); sudo mongosh --quiet --username nexus-sharded-admin --password \$KF --authenticationDatabase admin --host 127.0.0.1:27017 --eval 'db.getSiblingDB(\"config\").shards.find({}, {_id:1, host:1}).toArray()'"

observe.what: 2 shards registered via mongos: shard-1 (host string shard-1/.77,.78,.79:27018) + shard-2 (shard-2/.80,.56,.57:27018) -- the config.shards collection mongos reads to route (ADR-0040)

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.77 "KF=\$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-mongo/keyfile | tr -d '\n'); sudo mongosh --quiet --username __system --password \$KF --authenticationDatabase local --authenticationMechanism SCRAM-SHA-256 --host 127.0.0.1:27018 --eval 'var s=rs.status(); print(s.set); s.members.forEach(function(m){print(m.name+\" \"+m.stateStr+\" health=\"+m.health)})'"

observe.what: shard-1 RS: exactly 1 PRIMARY + 2 SECONDARY, all health=1 -- each shard is itself a 3-node replica set (sharding x replication composition). Repeat at .80 for shard-2; .74:27019 for the config RS.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.58 "KF=\$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-mongo/keyfile | tr -d '\n'); sudo mongosh --quiet --username nexus-sharded-admin --password \$KF --authenticationDatabase admin --host 127.0.0.1:27017 --eval 'print(\"shard-1 chunks=\"+db.getSiblingDB(\"config\").chunks.countDocuments({shard:\"shard-1\"})); print(\"shard-2 chunks=\"+db.getSiblingDB(\"config\").chunks.countDocuments({shard:\"shard-2\"}))'"

observe.what: nexus_n_smoke.samples chunks distributed across BOTH shards (>=1 each) -- the hashed shard key on `k` spreads the 200 seed docs; this is the actual sharding proof (vs a single-shard RS)

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.59 "KF=\$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-mongo/keyfile | tr -d '\n'); sudo mongosh --quiet --username nexus-sharded-admin --password \$KF --authenticationDatabase admin --host 127.0.0.1:27017 --eval 'var d=db.getSiblingDB(\"nexus_n_smoke\").samples.findOne({k:50}); print(d ? d.v : \"NULL\")'"

observe.what: a {k:50} lookup via the SECOND mongos (.59) returns data-50 -- mongos targets the chunk's owning shard transparently; both routers are interchangeable (round-robin DNS mongos.nexus.lab)

whatProves: cluster-status reports the genuine sharded MongoDB topology -- 2 shard replica-sets registered with the config-server RS, each shard a healthy 1-PRIMARY+2-SECONDARY set, a sharded collection whose chunks span both shards, and stateless mongos routers that resolve a keyed lookup to the right shard. These are the exact introspection sources the future MongoShardedAdapter cluster-status verb reads, including the role-split auth (nexus-sharded-admin@admin via mongos; __system@local on the shard mongods).
